reponse:
Martin raised two issues on the November 12 sync. Both have been picked up, but neither is fully resolved.

1. **Webhook signatures failing on sandbox.** Jake Whitfield took it that day [1]. He found that events sent by the TypeScript delivery worker are re-serialized before sending, so their signatures don't match, while retries sent by the old Rust path do verify [10]. A fix PR (core#1187) was opened on November 16 to sign the raw request body [16]. I couldn't find whether it has been merged or deployed. Tradewell had turned signature verification off on sandbox in the meantime [1].

2. **Per-seller payout schedules** (net-7 for about 200 top sellers, net-30 for the rest). Owen Park told Martin he would have a clear answer by Friday, November 20 [5]. Engineering estimated 3-4 weeks of work [4]. On November 16, Avi Kessler wrote that it won't ship for December 7, that the earliest date is late January, and that the ticket moved to Backlog with a 2027-Q1 target. He asked Owen to set expectations with Martin [4]. I didn't find a message showing that Martin has been told.

The payout schedule gap is the real risk to the December 7 date. Tradewell has said their seller comms depend on that date and on the top sellers keeping net-7 [1]. The KYC import is still on track for November 30 [3].
